decision: Show invoices as a dependency chain, blocked links dashed in red
why: A rejected shipment invoice blocks the transport document; the chain shows why an order can't ship.
alternative: A flat list of rejected invoices.
value: Root cause and blast radius are visible in one picture.

decision: Fix the catalog attribute (NCM) and resend, instead of patching each invoice
why: Patching invoices fixes today; the next order with the same SKU fails again.
alternative: Edit tax codes on rejected invoices only.
value: One correction stops the whole class of rejections.

decision: Resends run as an idempotent batch keyed by invoice number
why: The tax authority may accept some and time out on others; retries must not duplicate invoices.
alternative: Resend invoices one by one from the UI.
value: 38 resends in one action, safe to retry.

decision: Proposed codes come with retrieved context and scores
why: Tax codes have legal consequences; each proposal needs a checkable source.
value: People approve codes they can verify.
